description:
Across generations, farming has been built on experience, intuition, and a deep connection to the land. Today, that tradition continues — supported by technology.

In this story, farmers share how they combine inherited knowledge with AI-powered insights to care for their crops, adapt to changing climates, and make faster, more informed decisions. With tools like İmeceMobil, they can monitor plant health, optimize irrigation, and better understand what their fields need.

Behind the scenes, Microsoft Azure provides the cloud foundation that makes this possible — giving developers the scale, reliability, and performance needed to build and run solutions like İmeceMobil.

But while the tools are evolving, the heart of farming remains the same — it’s about listening to the land and carrying a legacy forward.

Read more: https://aka.ms/AA107bzq
title: How Technology Supports a New Generation of Farmers
